claim: The NCCIS Climate Services catalogue lists climate projections, climatological conditions, historical weather and climate extremes, and links to additional decision-support resources. It is a lead for source discovery, not proof of neighborhood-scale suitability.

coverage.place_label: South Africa; coverage varies by linked product

method.description: Catalogue page inspected as a source-discovery step; individual linked collections have not yet been fully assessed.

uncertainty.description: The catalogue page does not provide one common resolution, date range, data access method, license, or quality profile for all linked products.

review.rationale: Discovery lead pending dataset-level metadata and license review.

limitations: A link in a catalogue is not verification that a dataset can be downloaded or reused.
Any selected product must be checked for date, scenario, geographic coverage, spatial resolution, method, and licensing.
National or provincial coverage should not be silently downscaled to street or parcel precision.
